label: Bible Study
prompt: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the _____ that is on the sea shore.
verse: And God gave Solomon wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and largeness of heart, even as the sand that is on the sea shore.
note: Solomon's wisdom, measured in beach sand — the same image God used for Abraham's descendants.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy _____ Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
verse: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
note: Timothy's faith had a family tree: grandmother Lois, mother Eunice, and then him.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And should not I spare Nineveh, that great city, wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand; and also much _____?
verse: And should not I spare Nineveh, that great city, wherein are more than sixscore thousand persons that cannot discern between their right hand and their left hand; and also much cattle?
note: Jonah ends with God's question about Nineveh's people — and 'also much cattle.' He cared about the animals too.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For our _____ is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:
verse: For our conversation is in heaven; from whence also we look for the Saviour, the Lord Jesus Christ:
note: KJV 'conversation' means way of life — Paul reminds Philippi, a Roman colony (Acts 16:12), where its true citizenship lies.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And he shall restore the lamb _____, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity.
verse: And he shall restore the lamb fourfold, because he did this thing, and because he had no pity.
note: David judged Nathan's story of the stolen lamb: restore it 'fourfold.' Nathan's reply: 'Thou art the man.'
